entries.title: Jonah 4:1
segments: ¶But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.

entries.title: Jonah 4:2
segments: And he prayed unto the LORD, and said, I pray thee, O LORD, [was] not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou [art] a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.

words.text: , when I was yet in my country

entries.title: Jonah 4:3
segments: Therefore now, O LORD, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for [it is] better for me to die than to live.

entries.title: Jonah 4:4
segments: Then said the LORD, Doest thou well to be angry? {Doest...: or, Art thou greatly angry?}

entries.title: Jonah 4:5
segments: ¶So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.

words.text: what would become of the city

entries.title: Jonah 4:6
segments: And the LORD God prepared a gourd, and made [it] to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd. {gourd: or, palmcrist: Heb. Kikajon} {was...: Heb. rejoiced with great joy}

words.text: , that it might be a shadow
. {gourd: or, palmcrist: Heb. Kikajon} {was...: Heb. rejoiced with great joy}

entries.title: Jonah 4:7
segments: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.

entries.title: Jonah 4:8
segments: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, [It is] better for me to die than to live. {vehement: or, silent}

words.text: And it came to pass, when the sun

entries.title: Jonah 4:9
segments: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, [even] unto death. {Doest...: or, Art thou greatly angry?} {I do well...: or, I am greatly angry}

entries.title: Jonah 4:10
segments: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night: {had pity: or, spared} {came...: Heb. was the son of the night}

entries.title: Jonah 4:11
segments: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and [also] much cattle?
